def _sequence_states(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        batch_size, width = seq.shape
        valid = seq.ne(0)
        lengths = valid.sum(dim=1)
        positions = torch.arange(width, device=seq.device).expand_as(seq)
        # Move each LEFT-padded history to the beginning without changing order.
        offsets = width - lengths
        compact_indices = (positions + offsets.unsqueeze(1)).clamp(max=width - 1)
        compact_emb = emb.gather(
            1, compact_indices.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, self.hidden_units)
        )
        packed = nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence(
            compact_emb, lengths.clamp(min=1).cpu(),
            batch_first=True, enforce_sorted=False,
        )
        packed_out, _ = self.gru(packed)
        compact_out, _ = nn.utils.rnn.pad_packed_sequence(
            packed_out, batch_first=True, total_length=width,
        )
        # Restore states to the original positions used by positive/negative targets.
        aligned_indices = (positions - offsets.unsqueeze(1)).clamp(min=0)
        out = compact_out.gather(
            1, aligned_indices.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, self.hidden_units)
        )
        return out.masked_fill(~valid.unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
